description: Requires a JWT. Your publish allowance: for each kind (rig · mcp · agent) how many you have live (used), your cap (null = no cap) and what is left. A free account publishes 5 rigs, 2 MCP server listings and 1 agent on the market; the Studio ($249 a month, studio_doors) lifts the caps; unpublishing frees a slot. Every publish door (rig_publish, registry_list_server, agent_create, the site) refuses at the cap with {error:'publish_cap', kind, used, cap, upgrade:'/pricing'} — read this first.
name: publish_allowance
title: What you may still publish
